note: GitHub rate-limit cost of one call to each GitHub MCP tool, read from the handler source at the pinned commit. graphqlPoints is the primary GraphQL budget (connection requests / 100, at least 1; a mutation counts 1); restCore is the number of REST core requests. Assumes the server's default configuration: lockdown mode off and the IFC-labels feature flag off, so no repository-visibility or lockdown lookups are added. Log bodies downloaded from the signed redirect URL are not core API requests. record.mjs resets verified to false when the pinned commit changes; re-read each entry's source and set it back to true.

pull_request_read:get_check_runs.calls: REST PullRequests.Get for the head SHA, then Checks.ListCheckRunsForRef

pull_request_read:get_review_comments.calls: one GraphQL query: reviewThreads(first: 30) with comments(first: 100) each, 31 connection requests

get_job_logs:run.calls: REST Actions.ListWorkflowJobs, then Actions.GetWorkflowJobLogs per failed job (one failed job here)

update_pull_request:draft.calls: GraphQL isDraft query, GraphQL markPullRequestReadyForReview mutation, then REST PullRequests.Get for the result
